data.title: 雪之下雪乃 · 家庭餐厅
data.description: 【雪之下雪乃 · 家庭餐厅】傍晚热闹的家庭餐厅一角，雪乃优雅地用刀叉切开眼前的汉堡肉，清冷的侧颜在暖黄色吊灯下显得格外柔和。她轻轻拭了拭嘴角，将目光移向对面——「偶尔来这种充满平民烟火气的地方倒也别有风味。今天就破例听你聊聊那些无聊的话题吧。」
data.action: 坐在家庭餐厅卡座用刀叉切汉堡肉，暂时停住餐具并看向对面的同行者
data.promptProse: Yukino pauses her knife and fork above the partly cut hamburger steak and looks toward the unseen person opposite her restaurant booth. White shirt and long casual coat retain her selected outfit. The medium view includes the meal and water glass at the table edge, with other tables receding beyond the booth back. Warm pendant light softens her composed expression and glints on utensils, casting distinct plate and glass shadows below.
